scope: 27 C and 125 C, tt/ss/ff/sf/fs global corners, VDD 1.8 V, no mismatch, ideal drivers (PROPOSED range, not ratified)
report_klt_client_note: klt_version in report_provenance is the client that produced the report; pins.klt_client is the generator-time default client

rtl_trace_pins.time_base: 1 cycle = 1 ns (study assumption, not a silicon frequency claim)
rtl_trace_pins.sampling: strobes sampled 0.1 ns after each rising clock edge; zero-width delta glitches not exported

assumptions.latch_hold_adapter: enable set at sense_en rise, cleared at busy fall; no delay; RWL is NOT held (RTL timing)
assumptions.shared_circuit: sim/refresh-op circuit body (ideal drivers; column driver is #114/#117)
